expectation.notes: Single target passage on p2: truncating to 256 dims with snowflake-arctic-embed-m-v1.5 yields a 12x reduction in index size with under 2% retrieval degradation (via scalar quantization). The answer must contain '12x'. Exclude the p3 comparison-table rows (bge/gte have no Matryoshka support) and works cited; a good graph cites exactly one supporting node.
